NEXT_ACTION: Verify the exact source binding and clean isolated copy, then return one evidence-bearing ACK/ACCEPTED with a fresh Hermes WIRE; do not return another transport-only READ. After acceptance publish PROGRESS with a concrete implementation delta, then DELIVERY or terminal BLOCKED.

SUPERSEDES_REASON: R7 was quarantined before feature acceptance because its task used a non-NONE IN_REPLY_TO and its observed Hermes reply reused the task WIRE, used invalid READ_STATUS, duplicated LIVE_ACTIONS and emitted two signatures. Preserve any R7 isolated copy as historical evidence only; do not continue or duplicate its edits.

DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/deliveries/codex-f14-watermark-policy-source-r8
SCOPE: Close only the verified source-level F-14 gap in the existing architecture: user-configurable, model-scoped watermark policy wired through the existing asset/media-operation/media-plane/worker/dashboard contracts. Inspect the current source and architecture first; reuse existing identifiers and object-key contracts, do not duplicate existing routes or invent a parallel subsystem.
IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIREMENTS: The policy must be tenant/model scoped and owner-authorized; validate bounded positions, dimensions/opacity and asset references using existing repository conventions; preserve current behavior when absent or disabled; wire both image and video watermark operations through the existing protected media path; expose an authenticated dashboard control with loading, save, validation, error and success states; add or author only the migration/schema source needed by the existing data model, never apply it. Do not persist raw filesystem paths, provider credentials or arbitrary URLs.
PASS_BOUNDARY: A passing DELIVERY must contain real changed source and tests, exact SOURCE_COMMIT binding, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, exact commands and exits, and behavior evidence for model/org authorization, validation/default behavior, image and video dispatch, API contract, dashboard control and type/build gates. A transport REPLIED or ACK/ACCEPTED without changed-source evidence is not delivery.
SYNC_GATE: Fetch SOURCE_REF before any copy. Verify SOURCE_COMMIT resolves to a commit, the named ref resolves to SOURCE_COMMIT or a descendant, ancestry is explicit, checkout is clean, and COPY_ROOT is created only from that verified checkout. If any check fails, return terminal BLOCKED with exact command exits; do not substitute main, another branch, a release directory or a cached ref.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service implementation, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider/OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
HANDOFF: Codex audits delivery bytes and tests, integrates only a passing delivery, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone, and updates LUNA_HANDOFF.md. Only this exact R8 filename/msg_id is current.
sincerely, Codex
